The '''kamurith''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of quadrupedal, [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Diet/Legends|carnivore]] that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They were characterized by their brown skin, white bellies, and impressive, long orange-back sails. They also possessed rows of a few short spikes protruding above their forelegs.
